description: Search Sentry metrics: counters, gauges, and distributions, for values, percentiles, totals, and trends over time. Returns individual events, counts, and aggregates; for grouped issue lists, use search_issues. For latency recorded on spans, use search_traces.

fields.description: Columns to return; omit unless you need exact columns. Include aggregates such as count() or avg() for statistics.

includeExplanation.description: Explain how the query was translated or repaired.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

anyOf.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

query.description: What to find, in natural language or Sentry search syntax. Put environment, release, and other filters here.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

sort.description: Sort field, - prefix for descending, such as -count() for aggregates. Omit unless you need a specific order.

name: search_metrics

values.description: The requested fields, keyed by field name.

buckets.description: The most recent buckets, oldest first.

incomplete.description: Data is still arriving, so the value may rise.

outsideRetention.description: Starts before the retention window, so older data is missing and the value will not change.

interval.description: Bucket size; null when Sentry chose it for the range.

peak.description: Highest bucket that is no longer receiving data.

total.description: Sum of all buckets; null for non-additive aggregates.

title: Search Metrics
